objects.description: Small, trivially copyable value-type class that wraps a 32-bit integer plugin version. Provides constexpr comparisons and access to the underlying value via value(). Intended for versioning of plug-ins and save-file migrations. No special construction or destruction requirements beyond standard object semantics.
Template specialization of std::hash for score::Version enabling use of Version as a key in unordered associative containers. Provides a call operator that hashes to the underlying 32-bit value.

functions.name: clamp
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename U, typename V>
inline auto clamp(T val, U min, V max)
functions.description: Clamps the input value val to the closed interval [min, max]. If val < min, returns min; if val > max, returns max; otherwise returns val. Useful for bounding a value within limits. Return type is deduced (common type of the conditional expression).
requirements: min must be less than or equal to max; otherwise the clamping semantics are ill-defined for the intended use.
Types T, U, and V must support comparison operations: val < min and val > max must be valid expressions.
The conditional expression must yield a single common, implicitly convertible return type for val, min, and max.
Arguments are passed by value; there are no side effects or state requirements.

functions.name: score::Version::Version
functions.description: Constructs a Version from a 32-bit signed integer value. Intended to represent a plug-in or save-file format version. Trivial, constexpr, and noexcept; stores the provided value.
requirements: v is an int32_t; any 32-bit signed integer value is accepted.
Object may be constructed in constant-evaluated contexts (constexpr).
No preconditions beyond providing a valid int32_t.

functions.name: score::Version::Version
functions.description: Copy-constructs a Version from another Version. Defaulted, trivial, constexpr, and noexcept by default rule for this type; creates an identical version value.
requirements: The source score::Version must be a valid, initialized object.
May be used in constant-evaluated contexts (constexpr).

functions.name: score::Version::operator=
functions.description: Copy-assigns this Version from another Version. Defaulted assignment operator; replaces this object's version value with the source's value.
requirements: Self-assignment is well-defined and safe.
Both this and the source object must be valid, initialized score::Version instances.

functions.name: score::Version::operator=
functions.description: Move-assigns this Version from another Version. Defaulted; functionally identical to copy assignment for this trivial type.
requirements: Self-assignment is well-defined and safe.
Both this and the source object must be valid score::Version instances.

functions.description: Checks equality between two Version instances by comparing their stored integer values.
requirements: No special preconditions; both objects must be valid score::Version instances.
Usable in constant-evaluated contexts (constexpr) and guaranteed not to throw (noexcept).

requirements: No special preconditions; callable on any valid score::Version instance.
Usable in constant-evaluated contexts (constexpr) and guaranteed not to throw (noexcept).

functions.name: std::hash<score::Version>::operator()
functions.description: Computes a hash value for a score::Version by returning its underlying integer value as a std::size_t. Suitable for use with unordered associative containers.
requirements: Input reference s must refer to a valid score::Version object.
For equal Versions (operator==), this hash produces identical values, satisfying the hashing requirement.
Noexcept: callers can rely on this function not throwing exceptions.
